subject: Banking
title: Alexander Hamilton's National Bank
description: One-minute skill: Alexander Hamilton's National Bank.

hook.text: Alexander Hamilton created America's first national bank in 1791. Thomas Jefferson fought him every step of the way.

buildup.text: Hamilton wanted a strong central bank to manage debt and stabilize the new nation.

discovery.text: The First Bank of the United States held government deposits, issued currency, and made loans.

twist.text: Congress refused to renew its charter in 1811. America's fear of centralized power killed its own successful bank.

climax.text: Hamilton built what worked. Jefferson feared what it meant. America has debated central banking power ever since.

punchline.text: Hamilton built the bank. Jefferson killed the charter. The debate never ended.

quiz.question: Why did Congress let the First Bank of the US expire?
